headline: [Financial Stocks] Kaiji Jin H1 EPS hits record 1.64 yuan, net asset value per share rises to 26.71 yuan - Finance
summary: Kaiji Jin reported first-half after-tax net profit of 28.44 billion yuan and EPS of 1.64 yuan, a record for the period. Net asset value per share rose to 26.71 yuan.
why: Kaiji Jin is a Taiwan-listed financial holding company, and its earnings and book value per share are key measures for investors in Taiwan's financial sector.
